prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. Young olive trees and green shoots on a washed muddy hillside shining in the sun, the water gone, and a family in silhouette, in ankle-length rough undyed wool robes and head-cloths, barefoot, looking down on it from the top of the slope, their backs to the camera. Bright morning after rain. Hopeful. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
